_comment: MIDORI -- the design language from benjaminloschen.com.
LAYER 1 of 3. This file carries ONLY what a theme owns: the palette, the
type families, and the metric constants derived from them. It does NOT
carry the per-app token mappings. Those live in each target's stylesheet,
are hand-written, and must never be generated -- obsidian/theme.css is 61%
comments and that design record is the point of this repo.
Palette values were EXTRACTED from the shipped stylesheets, not retyped,
so this file cannot drift from them by transcription error.
name: Midori

_comment: ui/heading is the serif; body is the prose sans; mono is code.
avg_advance_em is measured over a PROSE sample, not a pangram:
pangrams over-weight rare letters and run ~4% narrow.
type.heading: Spectral, ui-serif, Georgia, serif
type.avg_advance_source: M PLUS 1p, BoundsPen over a prose sample

_comment: From app/layout.tsx: 'ONLY THE WEIGHTS THE DESIGN SYSTEM CAN
ACTUALLY REACH'. 300 and 700 were deleted as unreachable.

metrics.ch_advance_source: M PLUS 1p, advance of U+0030 ZERO -- what the CSS ch unit resolves to

palette._comment_border_base: Obsidian's border base, and the one neutral every hairline, hover wash, hr, scrollbar and shadow in obsidian/theme.css is mixed from. It was never a declared role: it reached silverbullet/midori.css and marktext/midori.css as the literal rgba(60, 58, 54, ...) copied by hand, which is why the alpha varies per use and the colour never did.
